rules.justification: Systolic blood pressure ≥140 mmHg is the clinical threshold for elevated systolic blood pressure (HPO class HP:0004421).
Systolic blood pressure ≥140 mmHg is a manifestation of hypertension (HPO class HP:0000822), which is a broader category.
Total cholesterol ≥240 mg/dl is the clinical threshold for hypercholesterolemia (HPO class HP:0003124).
Heart rate >100 bpm is the clinical threshold for tachycardia (HPO class HP:0001649).
ST depression ≥1 mm is the clinical threshold for ST segment depression (HPO class HP:0012250).

Presence of any major coronary vessel stenosis (≥1 vessel) is associated with coronary artery stenosis (HPO class HP:0005145). This is an approximate mapping as vessel count alone does not fully define stenosis severity.
Typical and atypical angina are recognized manifestations of angina pectoris (HPO class HP:0001681).
Any chest pain type other than asymptomatic indicates presence of chest pain (HPO class HP:0100749), a broader category.
Fasting blood sugar >120 mg/dl is interpreted as impaired fasting glucose (HPO class HP:0025691), an approximate mapping as the exact threshold for impaired glucose is 100-125 mg/dl.
Resting ECG finding of left ventricular hypertrophy directly maps to HPO class HP:0001712.
Exercise-induced angina is a recognized manifestation of angina pectoris (HPO class HP:0001681).

rules.justification: Systolic blood pressure ≥140 mmHg is the clinical threshold for elevated systolic blood pressure (HPO class HP:0004421).
Systolic blood pressure ≥140 mmHg is a manifestation of hypertension (HPO class HP:0000822), which is a broader category.
Total cholesterol ≥240 mg/dl is the clinical threshold for hypercholesterolemia (HPO class HP:0003124).
Heart rate >100 bpm is the clinical threshold for tachycardia (HPO class HP:0001649).
ST depression ≥1 mm is the clinical threshold for ST segment depression (HPO class HP:0012250).

Presence of any major coronary vessel stenosis (≥1 vessel) is associated with coronary artery stenosis (HPO class HP:0005145). This is an approximate mapping as vessel count alone does not fully define stenosis severity.
Typical and atypical angina are recognized manifestations of angina pectoris (HPO class HP:0001681).
Any chest pain type other than asymptomatic indicates presence of chest pain (HPO class HP:0100749), a broader category.
Fasting blood sugar >120 mg/dl is interpreted as impaired fasting glucose (HPO class HP:0025691), an approximate mapping as the exact threshold for impaired glucose is 100-125 mg/dl.
Resting ECG finding of left ventricular hypertrophy directly maps to HPO class HP:0001712.
Exercise-induced angina is a recognized manifestation of angina pectoris (HPO class HP:0001681).
